title: Area notes (1/3, simple-dispatcher): same docs/areas/ registry, README and guard test
description:
## As asked

Piece 1 of 3 of LIN-4347 (simple-dispatcher half). Repository: simple-dispatcher. The small second PR of piece 1; lands after the LinearViewer half, whose `docs/areas/README.md` format and guard test it mirrors.

**What this piece delivers.** The same `docs/areas/` shape in simple-dispatcher, so the grounding line added in LinearViewer (it names no repository) also finds notes here.

**Approach (from the approved plan):**

* `docs/areas/areas.json`: a code-only, first-match registry whose areas (with slugs) come from `docs/module-map.md`.
* `docs/areas/README.md`: same format and one-home rule as LinearViewer's (adapted, not cross-referenced as code: the two repositories share no test code).
* Its own copy of the guard test, four checks: every notes file is named by a registry area; every cited path exists; each waiting entry's first cited path maps to that note's area; each note under a byte cap (about 6 KB). Notes cite files, not line numbers.
* Seed notes from any simple-dispatcher entries among the open rows of LinearViewer's `docs/plans/survey/broad-options.md` and John's 7/8 Nov comments on LIN-4347 (most seeds are LinearViewer's; an area with no file is fine).
* Mention `docs/areas/` in `docs/module-map.md` if that is where the repo describes its layout.

**Testing strategy:** the guard test fails on each of the four invalid mutations and passes on the seeded tree; existing suite green.

**Acceptance:** PR merged to simple-dispatcher main with registry, README, guard test and any seeds; CI green.

**Starting point.** The parent LIN-4347's approved plan (revision 2, in its description under `## Implementation Plan`, read in full before starting) and the builder notes in its approving `### Plan Review Verdict` (comment `0ae2970d-05bf-48e7-aa4d-ca8ebd715312`) are this piece's starting point. Follow them; where the code shows them wrong, change course and say so on LIN-4347. The parent's `## As asked` block, its 7 Nov note and its `## Size of the move (the person's call)` comment hold the scope and John's rulings.

Session fit: fits one session
Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4347's approving plan-review (comment 0ae2970d-05bf-48e7-aa4d-ca8ebd715312, rev 2)
Grounding commits: `eeda7e44` (JKershaw/LinearViewer), `07c88f7` (simple-dispatcher). Re-check drift from these before building; LIN-4369 PR #2356 and LIN-4370 touch `lib/prompt-template-defs.js` and `tests/unit/prompt-size-budget.test.js` next, so rebase onto whichever lands first.

*End of what was asked. Steps write below this line; nothing above it changes.*

## Outcome

Implemented and merged: PR [https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/329](<https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/329>), squash `4aee0c9` on simple-dispatcher `main`. It adds `docs/areas/` (a six-area code-only first-match registry, the README and four seeded notes), the guard `test/area-notes.test.js`, and pointers in `docs/module-map.md` and CLAUDE.md.

It follows LIN-4347's approved plan (rev 2), with one reported departure: a `test-harnesses` area for the heavy-test seeds, accepted in review. CI was green on the PR and on `main`. After the merge, `docs/areas/README.md` and `docs/areas/areas.json` resolve on `origin/main`.

The full history is preserved in the task snapshots and the comment trail (implementation, review and close-out comments).

parent.title: After the merge: read it blind, ask the builder, tidy what it left

comments.body:
**Handover from LIN-4371 (LinearViewer, PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2357): seeds for simple-dispatcher's `docs/areas/`.**

LinearViewer's format is fixed in its `docs/areas/README.md`, and its guard is `tests/unit/area-notes.test.js`. Copy the shape: `## Lessons` and `## Waiting`, cite files never line numbers, and start each waiting entry with the file it is about. LIN-4371 turned `docs/plans/survey/broad-options.md` into a pointer. The open rows about simple-dispatcher's code now wait for this ticket. They are quoted from the tally as it stood at LinearViewer `eeda7e44`. Check each against SD's HEAD before seeding it, and drop any row that has landed:

- **Settings as one described list** (name, type, default, bounds, what `0` means), read through one reader, re-readable instead of fixed at require time. Named by LIN-4127 (C, D), LIN-4182 (C) and LIN-4183 (E: "config at require time is the real cost of this area"). Likely file: `config.js`.
- **An acknowledged outbox for runner → Harbour posts.** Named by LIN-4165 (D: a feedback outbox) and LIN-4195 (C: a typed telemetry channel). Volume stops being a risk for any relay.
- **One shared transcript fold** across simple-dispatcher and runner-kit. Named by LIN-4203 and LIN-4195. LinearViewer's half is noted under runs-and-dispatch (`lib/runner-kit/runner.mjs`).
- **A cross-repo "how long a session stays resumable" contract.** Named by LIN-4164 (D). Harbour's copy is `REAP_INACTIVITY_MS` in `lib/unanswered-decisions.js`, which mirrors SD's `config.js` (LIN-4173). LinearViewer's half is noted.
- **A flag registry with retirement** (flags that are always on get deleted). Named by LIN-4127 (D); it might merge with "settings as one list".
- **Cut `opencode-runner.js`'s size** (1,966 lines when it was named). Named by LIN-4203 (global).
- **Mutant anchors checked by `npm test`.** Named by LIN-4196 (C: "cheap and outside this ticket").
- **One process-group termination helper.** From LIN-4196's builder: `groupAlive`/`stopGroup` in `run-mutations.js` is "another ad-hoc copy, beside `reapers.js` and several tests".
- **A system test importing another repo's internals.** `park-read` imports Harbour's `lib/` files, where the HTTP tests didn't couple to layout. Named by LIN-4239 (q6), as a precedent to watch.

Rows that had landed (one Stop sequence, LIN-4218; the shared harness, LIN-4219; a contract note per system scenario, LIN-4187) are not carried.

**Implementation: PR open, CI green.** PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/329 (branch `feat/lin-4372-area-notes`, head `bc43ef8`, based on `07c88f7`, which is still simple-dispatcher's `main`).

**What landed**
- `docs/areas/areas.json`: a code-only, first-match registry with six areas, following `docs/module-map.md`'s module groups: `loop-and-routing`, `launch-and-harnesses`, `stop-hook-and-relay`, `reapers-and-liveness`, `state-and-config` and `test-harnesses`.
- `docs/areas/README.md`: the same format and one-home rule as LinearViewer's, adapted.
- `test/area-notes.test.js`: this repo's own copy of the four checks. It also checks that every root module has an area (the twin of the module-map census), that every area matches a file, and that none matches `docs/`.
- Pointers in `docs/module-map.md` and CLAUDE.md's "Where the detail lives".

**Seeds, checked against HEAD (the open questions answered)**
- `config.js` (state-and-config): settings as one described list. **Merged with the flag registry and retirement** into one entry. Both are about `config.js`, a flag is one kind of setting, and two entries would give one item two homes. The entry says the flag half can land first.
- `config.js` (state-and-config): the resumability contract, `REAP_INACTIVITY_MS` mirrored by Harbour's fixed copy. SD's value can be overridden from the environment; Harbour's can't.
- `feedback.js` (stop-hook-and-relay): the acknowledged outbox. Only terminal posts retry (LIN-3208), and only usage records keep an acknowledged ledger.
- `request-usage.js` (stop-hook-and-relay): the shared transcript fold, `walkRequestRecords` here and `foldTranscriptMessages` in runner-kit.
- `opencode-runner.js` (launch-and-harnesses): cut its size. It is 1,836 lines at `07c88f7`; it was 1,966 when LIN-4203 named it.
- `test/system/mutation/run-mutations.js` (test-harnesses): mutant anchors are not checked by `npm test`.
- `test/system/park-read.test.js` (test-harnesses): it imports Harbour's internals, a precedent to watch.
- **Dropped as landed:** the one process-group termination helper. LIN-4223 added `test/system/harness/stop-group.js` and `test/harness-kill-census.test.js` enforces it. `run-mutations.js` imports it, and `reapers.js` deliberately uses `signal-guard.js`. LIN-4218, LIN-4219 and LIN-4187 are not carried.

**Departure from the plan, with reason:** one area, `test-harnesses` (`e2e-*.js`, `test/system/`, `experiments/`), is not a production module group. Two seeds concern the heavy test tier, and no production module owns them. It grows out of the module map's `e2e-*.js` bullet. The registry is still code-only, with no `docs/` patterns. No cut to the `## As asked` block.

**Witnesses**
- **Guard against real-tree defects:** each defect was written to disk and failed the guard with the right check: an unregistered note gives check 1, a missing cited path gives check 2, a wrong-area entry gives check 3, a 7,139-byte note gives check 4, and an unplaced `brand-new-module.js` fails the placement test. With the tree restored, the files diffed identical and the test passed 11 of 11.
- **`npm test`:** 4,261 passed, 0 failed, 5 skipped.
- **CI:** `unit tests` passed on PR #329.

Merging is left to review.

## Review — LIN-4372

I reviewed head `bc43ef8` (PR https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/329, branch `feat/lin-4372-area-notes`). Its base is `07c88f7`, which is still `origin/main`: nothing has landed on simple-dispatcher since the ticket was created.

CI: green. `unit tests` passed on `bc43ef8` (run 42439852368). I also ran `npm test` locally on the branch: 4,266 tests, 4,261 passed, 0 failed, 5 skipped.

### Scope against what was asked
The PR changes 9 files and adds 400 lines. It changes nothing outside the plan's places: `docs/areas/` (the registry, README and four notes), `test/area-notes.test.js`, a pointer in `docs/module-map.md` and a line in CLAUDE.md's "Where the detail lives". Nothing in the PR runs in production.

There is one departure from the plan: the `test-harnesses` area (`e2e-*.js`, `test/system/`, `experiments/`). It is reasoned, and it was reported on LIN-4347 (comment of 02:48 UTC). Two of the handed-over seeds concern the heavy test tier, and no production module owns it, so the extra area is the honest home for them. The registry is still code-only: a test pins that no area matches `docs/`. I accept the departure. It narrows nothing in the `## As asked` block.

### The As-asked block, one item at a time
- **The same `docs/areas/` shape, so LinearViewer's grounding line finds notes here.** Met. The README, the registry and the notes sit at the paths the line names. The line only takes effect after the merge (ledger item 1).
- **`areas.json`: code-only, first-match, areas from `docs/module-map.md`.** Met. There are six areas, five of them the module map's groups in seam order. First match is pinned by the `areaOf` unit test. Every root `.js` module has an area, and a placement test enforces that.
- **README: the same format and one-home rule as LinearViewer's, adapted rather than shared as code.** Met. It has `## Lessons` and `## Waiting`, cites files never line numbers, and requires each waiting entry to start with the file it concerns. The one-home rule is restated, and the README says outright that the two repos share no code.
- **Its own copy of the guard, four checks, a cap of about 6 KB.** Met. Check 1 is the slug, check 2 is that a cited path exists (a `:12` suffix fails it), check 3 is the first path's area (plus "cites no file" and unknown headings), and check 4 caps a note at 6144 bytes. It goes beyond the plan, harmlessly: the root-module placement test, every area matching a file, and no area matching `docs/`.
- **Seeds from the open simple-dispatcher rows and John's 7/8 Nov comments.** Met. I re-checked all nine handed-over rows against HEAD:
  - `opencode-runner.js` is 1,836 lines.
  - `config.js` has 136 `process.env` reads.
  - `config.js` reads 11 flags through `envFlag`, and 8 of them default on.
  - `postRecordsWithLedger` and `walkRequestRecords` exist.
  - Each mutant in `run-mutations.js` uses a `find:` anchor.
  - `park-read.test.js` imports Harbour's `lib/session-telemetry.js` and `lib/dispatch-terminal.js`.
  - The cross-repo claims hold on LinearViewer's `origin/main`: `lib/unanswered-decisions.js` mirrors `REAP_INACTIVITY_MS`, and `foldTranscriptMessages` is in `lib/runner-kit/runner.mjs`.
  - Dropping the process-group helper is correct. `run-mutations.js` imports `test/system/harness/stop-group.js` (LIN-4223).
  - Merging the flag registry into the settings entry keeps one home for one item.
  - John's 7 Nov and 8 Nov comments name only LinearViewer files, so no simple-dispatcher seeds were missed.
- **Mention `docs/areas/` in `docs/module-map.md`.** Met, and CLAUDE.md's index points there too.
- **Testing strategy: the guard fails on each of the four invalid mutations, and the suite stays green.** Met, and I checked it independently (below).

### Mutation check (each mutation reverted afterwards; the tree is clean)
- I deleted each check's code path in `checkAreaNotes` in turn: check 1, check 2's `exists`, check 3's area comparison, check 3's "cites no file", check 3's heading check, and check 4's cap. **Each one turned exactly its own mutation test red** (10 passed, 1 failed each time).
- Real-tree defects all failed "every note passes the four checks":
  - a `config.js` entry appended to `test-harnesses.md`;
  - a `feedback.js:12` cite;
  - a `^docs/` pattern added to the registry, which failed the code-only test;
  - an untracked root `brand-new-module.js`, which failed the root-module placement test.
- One finding, not blocking: the placement test has no mutation inside the test. Removing its filter leaves it green, because the real tree has no homeless module today. The real-tree witness above covers it, the same way `module-map-census` is covered. No change asked.

### Regression check
Most of the PR is new files. `git log -- docs/module-map.md CLAUDE.md` shows only the LIN-4240, LIN-4239, LIN-4218 and LIN-4203 rewrites. The PR adds lines and touches none of their content. Nothing was reverted, and nothing is re-applied.

### Isolated, or one of a class?
The PR is the simple-dispatcher instance of the class "a repository whose prompts carry the Area Notes line". LinearViewer's instance is LIN-4371 (merged). These are the only two repositories Harbour dispatches to, so no instance is left unhandled. The change is isolated.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (the ticket's own delivery: "the grounding line also finds notes here"). LinearViewer's repo-neutral `## Area Notes` line resolves on a simple-dispatcher task only once PR #329 is on `main`. CI exercises the files, not that resolution. **Settle after the merge:** `git show origin/main:docs/areas/README.md` and `git show origin/main:docs/areas/areas.json` both succeed on simple-dispatcher. This also discharges the LIN-4371 close-out note on LIN-4347 (02:37 UTC), which says those prompts point at a README that does not exist yet. That note's ledger claim, "the line serves simple-dispatcher too", is settled by the same check. **Rollback:** revert the PR's squash commit. The change is pure docs plus one test, with no data or consumers in a new shape.
- Discharged: the cross-repo prose claims in the notes name Harbour paths in prose, which the guard does not check by design. I verified them by hand on LinearViewer's `origin/main` (see above).

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger

The work is complete against every sentence of the As-asked block, and the guard is mutation-checked. Close-out has nothing to fix. It should merge PR #329, then run the post-merge check above.

## Close-out — LIN-4372

**Merged:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/329, squash-merged at 2026-11-08 02:53:20 UTC as `4aee0c9`. The merge was pinned with `--match-head-commit` to `bc43ef8`, the head that review approved and CI passed on. Base `07c88f7` was still `main`, and the PR was CLEAN, so there was no rebase or conflict.

**How it meets what was asked:** see the review of 02:52 UTC (comment `774301ed`). Every sentence of the As-asked block is met: the six-area code-only first-match registry, the README in LinearViewer's format, this repo's own four-check guard (`test/area-notes.test.js`, mutation-checked), four seeded notes reconciled against HEAD, and pointers in `docs/module-map.md` and CLAUDE.md.

**Changes made at close-out:** none. Review asked for no fixes, and nothing was committed after the approval.

**CI**
- PR: `unit tests` passed on `bc43ef8` (run 42439852368).
- `main` after the merge: CI run 42440401739 passed on `4aee0c9`.

**Ledger**
- **Inside: the grounding line finds notes on simple-dispatcher.** Settled after the merge, with the check review named:
  - `git show origin/main:docs/areas/README.md` exited 0.
  - `git show origin/main:docs/areas/areas.json` exited 0.
  - `areas.json` parses, with six slugs: `loop-and-routing`, `launch-and-harnesses`, `stop-hook-and-relay`, `reapers-and-liveness`, `state-and-config`, `test-harnesses`.
  - A fresh `git clone --depth 1` of GitHub `main` (`4aee0c9`) has `docs/areas/`, with the README, registry and four notes. In it, resolving paths through the registry the way LinearViewer's `## Area Notes` line says to (first match) gives `feedback.js` → `stop-hook-and-relay`, `config.js` → `state-and-config`, `opencode-runner.js` → `launch-and-harnesses` and `test/system/park-read.test.js` → `test-harnesses`, each with its notes file present.
  - This also discharges LIN-4371's close-out note on LIN-4347 (02:37 UTC) and that ledger's claim that "the line serves simple-dispatcher too".
- **Rollback (named by review):** revert squash commit `4aee0c9`. It is docs and one test, with no data and no runtime consumers.
- **Discharged by review:** the cross-repo prose claims, checked by hand on LinearViewer `origin/main`.
- **Outside items:** none, so no follow-ups were filed.

**Deploy:** landed. The host checkout `~/development/simple-dispatcher` is at `4aee0c9`, and `watch-restart.sh` restarted `dispatcher.js` at 02:54:22 UTC, after the merge. The change has no runtime code path. Its effect is that a session cloned from `main` now carries `docs/areas/`, as the fresh clone shows.

**Related tickets**
- LIN-4374 (Todo) was blocked by this ticket and is now unblocked. It is left open, because it is its own piece of work.
- Parent LIN-4347 stays In Progress (pieces 2/3 and 3/3 remain). Its ledger claim is noted there.
